strategy.name: ackman-concentrated-catalyst
strategy.description: Concentrated long-only equity hedge fund style: high conviction, fundamental thesis, catalyst-driven. Objective is to MAKE MONEY — active PM, not passive hold. Equity-only book — options disabled by LP directive (2026-08-02).

returnAspiration.note: LP target +25% annual on NAV (soft). Ackman core drives near-term; SPCX satellite compounds — never sell but counts toward blended return. Never force trades/size to hit target. Options OFF.

positionCapacity.note: No fixed max position count. New entry allowed when buying_power >= minOrderUsd, cash >= minCashReservePct, invested <= maxPortfolioInvestedPct, conviction >= Media, and thesis doc exists. Prefer Ackman concentration; add names only if each gets meaningful size (>= minOrderUsd).

strategy.minCashReserveNote: Lowered from 10% to 8% per LP directive 2026-08-04 — deploy $15 SPCX satellite without AMZN trim; post-trade floor ~$10 on ~$117 NAV.
strategy.style: Bill Ackman — concentrated, activist mindset, quality + mispricing

options.disabledNote: LP (2026-08-02): do NOT use the options satellite policy. Ignore prior long-call/put rules even though broker L2 remains. No review_option_order / place_option_order. Equity-only.
options.accountNote: Agentic cash ••••3029 — option_level_2 may still show on broker; fund forbids options trading.
options.role: DISABLED — equity-only book per LP. Historical narrow satellite rules are inactive.

riskControls.stopLossNote: Hard stop backup solo si tesis intacta; exit primario = tesis rota (Ackman)

exitPolicy.note: Ackman NO vende por % fijo. Sale cuando: (1) tesis rota, (2) tesis realizada / fair value, (3) mejor idea en otro lado. Trims parciales opcionales — nunca automáticos por +25%.
exitPolicy.defaultTrimNote: Si trim: tamaño definido en thesis (ej. 30–50% al fair value), no regla mecánica global
